tool_input.content:
import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['WHP']

# Local London Partnership
# Barking: EEG=1, Dis=18, LTU=0 -> YTD=19
# Barnsbury: EEG=None, Dis=3, LTU=None -> YTD=3
ws['E7'] = '=SUMIF(WHP DATA!$B$4:$B$17,$C7,WHP DATA!$E$4:$E$17)'
ws['F7'] = '=SUMIF(WHP DATA!$B$4:$B$17,$C7,WHP DATA!$F$4:$F$17)'
ws['G7'] = '=SUMIF(WHP DATA!$B$4:$B$17,$C7,WHP DATA!$G$4:$G$17)'

ws['E8'] = '=SUMIF(WHP DATA!$B$22:$B$39,$C8,WHP DATA!$E$22:$E$39)'
ws['F8'] = '=SUMIF(WHP DATA!$B$22:$B$39,$C8,WHP DATA!$F$22:$F$39)'
ws['G8'] = '=SUMIF(WHP DATA!$B$22:$B$39,$C8,WHP DATA!$G$22:$G$39)'

wb.save('output.xlsx')
